notes.title: Bug fix, again
notes.notes: The issue of numerical abnormalities in the new disciple Mengxian before unlocking the 999 attribute limit has been fixed.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fix the issue of files being falsely reported and deleted by the system's antivirus software.

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes: The bug causing the disciple's loss has been fixed.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: The issue of missing rewards for players in their second reincarnation has been fixed. To retrieve the lost rewards, players need to restart the game after completing their third reincarnation.

notes.title: 16th April "Cultivation Fantasy" update, adding 7 new disciples!
notes.notes:
16th April "Cultivation Fantasy" update:
1. Added autoselling function, cost 500,000 spirit stones to unlock, click on the abacus in the upper left corner after unlocking to open autoselling, the equipment made by disciples through the Heavenly Worker's Platform and Casting Pool will be automatically converted into spirit stones.
2. Click on the Immortal cultivation gameplay adjustments to increase the reincarnation function and rewards, to reach a certain number of reincarnation can directly unlock the branch plot achievement, as well as unlocking because of locking the task can not be obtained by the disciple.
3. New five-clawed dragon & new disciple related achievements.
4. Adjusted the logic of automatic equipment production and automatic training, when the material and spirit stone is not enough will hang up the automatic process, after meeting the conditions will automatically continue to production and training process.
5. Added 7 new disciples.

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug with the display of English currency.
Fixed an issue where the setting to show/hide disciple idle chatter sound would not turn off.

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug comes from last update

notes.title: Update
notes.notes: After obtaining the Divine General Card by defeating the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon, disciples no longer need to equip the Transformation skill to achieve the ability to break through the 999 damage limit.

notes.title: The new version of Cultivation Fantasy is here on March 13th!
notes.notes:
After months of research and development, we've added a new clicker game for those who like to play a little cookie, so don't miss it!
To unlock this game, you will need to complete the 10th main quest and deliver the "Deputy Sovereign Runner: Back Mountain Encounter".
If you encounter any bugs or problems during the game, you can join the QQ group feedback: 478040609!
We look forward to your trial game, thank you again for your support!

notes.title: "Cultivation of Immortal Payoff Legend" short-term update objectives
notes.notes:
December 29th "Cultivation of Immortal Payoff Legend" short-term update objectives: 

1. Unlock the 999 (Life 9999) limit for disciples. 
2. Add 8 new maps with "Amazing Refinement Difficulty". 
3. Increase the Battle Ranking. 
4. Add clicker gameplay (similar to cookie clicker).
5. More clear and convenient, click on the task to jump to the required props/materials interface. (Quest Jump Optimization is now updated! Welcome to experience more!)
In addition, I wish you all a happy New Year's Day and all the best in health~!
